and nothing else.

(`nodes/release.py`).

delete.description: Forgets a node: its link closes, its sessions leave the lists, and it can no longer link.

get.description: What can be started here (a node's are in GET /v1/nodes).

schema.title: Response List Runtimes V1 Runtimes Get
Response List Sessions V1 Sessions Get

delete.description: Stops the session (`capabilities.terminate`); an archived one is deleted from the archive.

post.description:
Ends the session (closes its tmux pane, archives it on Remote Control) and keeps its conversation
to read under `archived_at` (`capabilities.archive`).

get.description:
Structured conversation items after `after` (0 = the latest `limit`). Only for sessions whose
capabilities include `conversation`; others have a screen instead.

post.description: Hide it from the lists (`{"hidden": false}` shows it again); the same on every device.

put.description:
Which push notifications it sends: all, only when it needs the owner, or none; the same on every
device.
Where it runs, for a session whose source does not say (`capabilities.place`); empty fields clear.

post.description:
Reads the session's whole log for the folder its tool calls ran in: a suggestion to place it there
(PUT /placement), nothing is kept.

A client looks at the session (sent on opening and every few seconds while open), or the owner marks
it unread to come back to.

Asks for a short version of the session's last reply. `pending` means it is being made: the session
list is pushed again once `reply_summary` is filled in.
Sets an HttpOnly cookie that authenticates /v1/stream for a same-origin page.
